store.persistence: Existing service.store under owner-specific derived namespace, no new persistent backend/service. Full upstream cognition serialization retains raw evidence and native provenance.
store.source_unit: One captured Source ID/native revision per chunk; full body, role/origin/object_ref/session, separate reported/captured clocks and original calendar_context.
store.opportunity: Caller supplies source-ID search function. Exact returned set/order retained after deduplication and actual owner/visibility checks; no widening or semantic filtering by this port.
store.freshness: sync_sources applies native revisions/deletions only to actual bound sources. New unbound sources are still discoverable via normal cache retrieval; no blanket global invalidation. Caller must invoke sync before serving cached results.
store.limitation: Immutable-message source granularity is explicit; this is not a mutable whole-document connector or a guarantee of discovering every new correction for repeated queries.

providers.generation: Existing VLLMClient.native_post chat/completions, no tool parser; original owned ledger, Host admission callback, upstream prompt/model/max_tokens/temperature and existing thinking setting. Returns actual usage to upstream without rebilling.
providers.embedding: Existing MeteredEmbeddings query/batch methods, original capacity/tokenizer/normalization/ledger path.
providers.retry: Upstream LLMSynthesizer configured with retries=0 in the checked recipe. No retry implemented in ports.
providers.failure: Malformed JSON through actual upstream synthesizer produces ok=False with no claims, retaining usage; mock HTTP only.
